name: Black Tail Bumble Bee
desc: Black Tail Bumble Bee (Bombus melanopygus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus melanopygus, the black-tailed bumble bee, black tail bumble bee or orange-rumped bumblebee, is a species of bumblebee native to western North America.
